changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7, as Quick Trig Conditions (was Quick Fill Trig Condition). With a trig held in GRID RECORDING, FILL steps FILL, NOT FILL and no lock; UP steps a ratio's first number and DOWN its second, 1:2 to 8:8.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
